However, it's important to clarify what "highest grossing film" means in this context:

*   **Director of the highest-grossing single film:** James Cameron ("Avatar", ~$2.9B)

A film director is one of the most pivotal members of any movie production. They are what gives the film its look and feel as the director attempts to bring together the best possible cast and crew to deliver a movie that captivates audiences, shapes culture and brings people to the theaters in droves.
There are some names in the movie business that are tapped to do it again and again. The Steven Spielbergs, James Camerons and Christopher Nolans are the names that Hollywood turns to, who have become almost as A-list as the actors on the screen and have been driving decades of box office success.
These are Hollywood’s best directors of all time, ranked by global box office gross.
> **Discover why these directors became Hollywood legends. Watch some of their biggest box office hits with DIRECTV.**
* * *

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
Here’s an overview of the top grossing film directors:

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **9. Tim Burton ($4.88 billion)**
Few directors have a more distinct and clear style than Tim Burton. Known for his Gothic fantasy vibes, Burton has been behind the camera of twisted comedies like _Beetlejuice_, _Edward Scissorhands_, _Mars Attacks!_ and _Alice in Wonderland_.
He put the Goth in Gotham with _Batman_ and _Batman Returns_, and he got his start on _Pee-wee’s Big Adventure_.
Burton’s most recent work was the follow-up to _Beetlejuice_ titled _Beetlejuice Beetlejuice_.
**Tim Burton’s highest-grossing film:**_Alice in Wonderland_ at $1.03 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **10. J.J. Abrams ($4.64 billion)**
J.J. Abrams became a go-to man in Hollywood with the massive success of _Lost_, which was the show of the early 2000s.
His first major film directorial job was _Mission: Impossible III_, which is when the series took a massive leap in production, before helping to revive the _Star Trek_ film series.
Abrams was then tasked to revive the _Star Wars_ film series, and _Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ remains his highest-grossing film of all time and top five overall.
**J.J. Abrams’s highest-grossing film:**_Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ at $2.07 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **11. Robert Zemeckis ($4.4 billion)**
Being behind one of the most iconic film franchises of the 1980s, Zemeckis directed all three _Back to the Future_ films, a culture-defining series.
He also directed _Forrest Gump_, for which he won an Academy Award, _Cast Away_, _Flight_ and the cult classic _Who Framed Roger Rabbit_.
**Robert Zemeckis’s highest-grossing film:**_Forrest Gump_, which brought in $678 million.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **12. Jon Favreau ($4.34 billion)**
Favreau got his start as an actor, breaking through with his role in _Swingers_. But he made his mark as a director with two very different films.
The first was _Elf_ in 2003, which remains a holiday classic. And then came _Iron Man_ and _Iron Man 2_, which helped kick off the Marvel Cinematic Universe and made him one of the most influential figures in that franchise.
Favreau made his own personal passion project in _Chef_ before finding his way into remakes of Disney classics in _The Jungle Book_ and _The Lion King_.
Favreau’s most recent endeavor as a director has been _The Mandalorian_ TV series and the new _Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu_ film, which hit theaters in May 2026.
**Jon Favreau’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lion King_ at $1.66 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **13. Ron Howard ($4.31 billion)**
Ron Howard has been an influential part of Hollywood since the late 1960s as an actor in _The Andy Griffith Show_ and _Happy Days_.
As a director, _Apollo 13_ made him a directorial household name. _A Beautiful Mind_, _Cinderella Man_ and _How the Grinch Stole Christmas_ showed off his versatility as a director among multiple genres.
**Ron Howard’s highest-grossing film:**_The Da Vinci Code_, which earned $758 million worldwide.

Directing a movie isn't an easy task. You have to have a vision for the story you want to tell and be able to execute it in a way that resonates with audiences. Success isn't easy to come by, either, especially when you're just starting out as a director, or if you're a well-known artist who makes a film that just doesn't resonate with moviegoers.
The highest-grossing directors are those who can direct amazing hit after amazing hit and continue to bring fans to the movies with each new release. Here are the top money-making directors today, based on data compiled by Statista in January 2026.

## Steven Spielberg: $10.7 billion
American director Steven Spielberg | Getty Images/GettyImages
Steven Spielberg has become a household name across his decades of directing experience and 37 films, which have earned him a whopping $10.7 billion at the box office. He has had successful standalone films like _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_, _Saving Private Ryan_, and _Schindler's List_, which won him an Oscar for Best Director in 1994. But his franchise movies have brought in big bucks as well. His highest-grossing film of all time was 1993's _Jurassic Park_, and in 1997 he returned for a sequel, _The Lost World: Jurassic Park,_ which also fetched a pretty penny.

## James Cameron: $9.8 billion
James Cameron on set | MERIE WALLACE/GettyImages
James Cameron also enjoyed enormous box office success with franchise films from the Terminator and Alien franchises as well as the Avatar movies. He comes in second place behind Spielberg, possibly because Spielberg has directed more films, but the films Cameron has directed have made big bucks. Three of the five highest-grossing films of all time—_Avatar, Avatar: The Way of Water_, and _Titanic_—were directed by Cameron.

## The Russo Brothers: $6.8 billion
Anthony and Joe Russo speaking at 2026 Comic-Con International: San Diego | Amy Sussman/GettyImages
The third-highest-grossing director is actually a pair of brothers who have made a name for themselves with comic-book superhero movies that ended up on the big screen. Anthony and Joe Russo are best known for their Marvel franchise movies, including _Captain America_ and Avengers films. _Avengers: Endgame_ is the second-highest-grossing movie of all time, and its prequel, _Avengers: Infinity War_, also makes the top 10 list.

## Peter Jackson: $6.6 billion
Peter Jackson, New Zealand director of The Lord of the Rings | Robert Patterson/GettyImages
Peter Jackson has directed films like _King Kong_ and documentaries about The Beatles, but it’s his work in Middle-earth that has made him the most money. Jackson's Lord of the Rings trilogy, released in 2001, 2002, and 2003, made him the most cash at the box office, followed by additional films covering the series' prequel, _The Hobbit_. In 2004, _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_, the final installment in the series, earned Jacksonthree Oscarsfor Best Picture, Best Writing, and Best Director. It was also his highest-grossing movie.

## Michael Bay: $6.5 billion
Michael Bay at "Transformers One" New York Premiere | Jamie McCarthy/GettyImages
Michael Bay has a reputation for directing action flicks that turn into summer box-office cash. His directing credits include blockbusters like _Pearl Harbor_, _Armageddon_, and _Bad Boys_. But his best commercial successes have come from the Transformers franchise, which includes movies like _Transformers_ and _Transformers: Age of Extinction_. His 2011 hit _Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ is his highest-grossing film.

## David Yates: $6.4 billion
David Yates at "Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets Of Dumbledore" Fan Events | Dia Dipasupil/GettyImages
David Yates has directed more than 20 films, with his forays into the Harry Potterfranchise making the most at the box office. He directed the last four films of the Harry Potter series, including _Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix, Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince,_ and the two-part _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_. He also added three Harry Potter-adjacent films to his box-office haul with the Fantastic Beasts movie series.

## Christopher Nolan: $6.1 billion
Christopher Nolan on the set of 'The Dark Knight Rises' | Bobby Bank/GettyImages
Christopher Nolan has a reputation for his unique approach to directing, and his body of work includes mind-bending films like _Inception_ and _Memento_ as well as sweeping historical dramas like _Oppenheimer_ and _Dunkirk_. His highest-grossing film, _The Dark Knight Rises_, is part of his gritty _Batman_ trilogy. But this list doesn't include his 2026 summer hit _The Odyssey_, which could give him an additional box-office boost.

## Ridley Scott: $5.0 billion
"Gladiator II" Conversation with Director Ridley Scott and Director Christopher Nolan | Vivien Killilea/GettyImages
Ridley Scotthas directed more than 50 films over his career, spanning decades with films like _Blade Runner,_ _Thelma & Louise,_ and _The Martian,_ which is his top-grossing film. He's also been involved with the Alien franchise and directed both _Gladiator_ and _Gladiator II_, building on success with multiple movies that take place in the same world.

## Tim Burton: $4.9 billion
Tim Burton on the set of Batman Returns | Sunset Boulevard/GettyImages
Tim Burton's quirky point of view comes through in his movies like _Edward Scissorhands_, _Beetlejuice,_ and _Ed Wood_ as well as his work on two Batman films in the 1990s. That unique directing style also shaped his take on _Alice in Wonderland_, which earned more cash than any of his other turns as a director.

## J.J. Abrams: $4.6 billion
J.J. Abrams at 'Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker' - UK film Premiere | Justin Goff Photos/GettyImages
J.J. Abrams hasn't directed many films, but the ones he has directed have gone on to become blockbusters and have earned him a spot on the list of the top 10 highest-grossing directors of all time. It helps that Abrams has directed films in successful movie franchises such as Star Wars, Star Trek, and Mission: Impossible. In fact, his highest-grossing film as a director came from _Star Wars: The Force Awakens_.

The director found greater success with later movies such as the shark thriller _Jaws_ (1975), the sci-fi family film _E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial_ (1982), and the war epic _Saving Private Ryan_ (1998).

Directing a movie isn't an easy task. You have to have a vision for the story you want to tell and be able to execute it in a way that resonates with audiences. Success isn't easy to come by, either, especially when you're just starting out as a director, or if you're a well-known artist who makes a film that just doesn't resonate with moviegoers.
The highest-grossing directors are those who can direct amazing hit after amazing hit and continue to bring fans to the movies with each new release. Here are the top money-making directors today, based on data compiled by Statista in January 2026.
texts.1:
## Steven Spielberg: $10.7 billion
American director Steven Spielberg | Getty Images/GettyImages
Steven Spielberg has become a household name across his decades of directing experience and 37 films, which have earned him a whopping $10.7 billion at the box office. He has had successful standalone films like _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_, _Saving Private Ryan_, and _Schindler's List_, which won him an Oscar for Best Director in 1994. But his franchise movies have brought in big bucks as well. His highest-grossing film of all time was 1993's _Jurassic Park_, and in 1997 he returned for a sequel, _The Lost World: Jurassic Park,_ which also fetched a pretty penny.
texts.2:
## James Cameron: $9.8 billion
James Cameron on set | MERIE WALLACE/GettyImages
James Cameron also enjoyed enormous box office success with franchise films from the Terminator and Alien franchises as well as the Avatar movies. He comes in second place behind Spielberg, possibly because Spielberg has directed more films, but the films Cameron has directed have made big bucks. Three of the five highest-grossing films of all time—_Avatar, Avatar: The Way of Water_, and _Titanic_—were directed by Cameron.
texts.3:
## The Russo Brothers: $6.8 billion
Anthony and Joe Russo speaking at 2026 Comic-Con International: San Diego | Amy Sussman/GettyImages
The third-highest-grossing director is actually a pair of brothers who have made a name for themselves with comic-book superhero movies that ended up on the big screen. Anthony and Joe Russo are best known for their Marvel franchise movies, including _Captain America_ and Avengers films. _Avengers: Endgame_ is the second-highest-grossing movie of all time, and its prequel, _Avengers: Infinity War_, also makes the top 10 list.
texts.4:
## Peter Jackson: $6.6 billion
Peter Jackson, New Zealand director of The Lord of the Rings | Robert Patterson/GettyImages
Peter Jackson has directed films like _King Kong_ and documentaries about The Beatles, but it’s his work in Middle-earth that has made him the most money. Jackson's Lord of the Rings trilogy, released in 2001, 2002, and 2003, made him the most cash at the box office, followed by additional films covering the series' prequel, _The Hobbit_. In 2004, _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_, the final installment in the series, earned Jacksonthree Oscarsfor Best Picture, Best Writing, and Best Director. It was also his highest-grossing movie.
texts.5:
## Michael Bay: $6.5 billion
Michael Bay at "Transformers One" New York Premiere | Jamie McCarthy/GettyImages
Michael Bay has a reputation for directing action flicks that turn into summer box-office cash. His directing credits include blockbusters like _Pearl Harbor_, _Armageddon_, and _Bad Boys_. But his best commercial successes have come from the Transformers franchise, which includes movies like _Transformers_ and _Transformers: Age of Extinction_. His 2011 hit _Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ is his highest-grossing film.
texts.6:
## David Yates: $6.4 billion
David Yates at "Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets Of Dumbledore" Fan Events | Dia Dipasupil/GettyImages
David Yates has directed more than 20 films, with his forays into the Harry Potterfranchise making the most at the box office. He directed the last four films of the Harry Potter series, including _Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix, Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince,_ and the two-part _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_. He also added three Harry Potter-adjacent films to his box-office haul with the Fantastic Beasts movie series.
texts.7:
## Christopher Nolan: $6.1 billion
Christopher Nolan on the set of 'The Dark Knight Rises' | Bobby Bank/GettyImages
Christopher Nolan has a reputation for his unique approach to directing, and his body of work includes mind-bending films like _Inception_ and _Memento_ as well as sweeping historical dramas like _Oppenheimer_ and _Dunkirk_. His highest-grossing film, _The Dark Knight Rises_, is part of his gritty _Batman_ trilogy. But this list doesn't include his 2026 summer hit _The Odyssey_, which could give him an additional box-office boost.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.
texts.3:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.
texts.4:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.
texts.5:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.
texts.6:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.
texts.7:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **9. Tim Burton ($4.88 billion)**
Few directors have a more distinct and clear style than Tim Burton. Known for his Gothic fantasy vibes, Burton has been behind the camera of twisted comedies like _Beetlejuice_, _Edward Scissorhands_, _Mars Attacks!_ and _Alice in Wonderland_.
He put the Goth in Gotham with _Batman_ and _Batman Returns_, and he got his start on _Pee-wee’s Big Adventure_.
Burton’s most recent work was the follow-up to _Beetlejuice_ titled _Beetlejuice Beetlejuice_.
**Tim Burton’s highest-grossing film:**_Alice in Wonderland_ at $1.03 billion worldwide.

### **10. J.J. Abrams ($4.64 billion)**
J.J. Abrams became a go-to man in Hollywood with the massive success of _Lost_, which was the show of the early 2000s.
His first major film directorial job was _Mission: Impossible III_, which is when the series took a massive leap in production, before helping to revive the _Star Trek_ film series.
Abrams was then tasked to revive the _Star Wars_ film series, and _Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ remains his highest-grossing film of all time and top five overall.
**J.J. Abrams’s highest-grossing film:**_Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ at $2.07 billion worldwide.

Being behind one of the most iconic film franchises of the 1980s, Zemeckis directed all three _Back to the Future_ films, a culture-defining series.
He also directed _Forrest Gump_, for which he won an Academy Award, _Cast Away_, _Flight_ and the cult classic _Who Framed Roger Rabbit_.

From wizards to dinosaurs to Homeric epics, the film industry is a multibillion-dollar business. Directors serve as the visionaries who keep audiences coming back for more.
This graphic uses January 2026 data from Statista to rank the 20 highest-grossing film directors in history based on the cumulative box office gross of their filmographies.
Each director’s top-grossing film has been included for reference, although 2026 releases such as _Disclosure Day_ and _The Odyssey_ have been excluded as they do not yet have final box-office figures.

# Ranked: The Highest-Grossing Directors Ever
## The King of the Box Office
Across 37 films, Steven Spielberg’s work has grossed more than $10.7 billion worldwide, making him the most commercially successful director in history.
Spielberg made his directorial debut at 17 years old with _Firelight_ (1964), which he later referred to as one of the worst films ever made. The director found greater success with later movies such as the shark thriller _Jaws_ (1975), the sci-fi family film _E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial_ (1982), and the war epic _Saving Private Ryan_ (1998).

James Cameron ranks second with $9.8 billion in lifetime box-office receipts. Three of the four highest-grossing films in history are his creations.

Directing a movie isn't an easy task. You have to have a vision for the story you want to tell and be able to execute it in a way that resonates with audiences. Success isn't easy to come by, either, especially when you're just starting out as a director, or if you're a well-known artist who makes a film that just doesn't resonate with moviegoers.
The highest-grossing directors are those who can direct amazing hit after amazing hit and continue to bring fans to the movies with each new release. Here are the top money-making directors today, based on data compiled by Statista in January 2026.

## Steven Spielberg: $10.7 billion
American director Steven Spielberg | Getty Images/GettyImages
Steven Spielberg has become a household name across his decades of directing experience and 37 films, which have earned him a whopping $10.7 billion at the box office. He has had successful standalone films like _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_, _Saving Private Ryan_, and _Schindler's List_, which won him an Oscar for Best Director in 1994. But his franchise movies have brought in big bucks as well. His highest-grossing film of all time was 1993's _Jurassic Park_, and in 1997 he returned for a sequel, _The Lost World: Jurassic Park,_ which also fetched a pretty penny.

## James Cameron: $9.8 billion
James Cameron on set | MERIE WALLACE/GettyImages
James Cameron also enjoyed enormous box office success with franchise films from the Terminator and Alien franchises as well as the Avatar movies. He comes in second place behind Spielberg, possibly because Spielberg has directed more films, but the films Cameron has directed have made big bucks. Three of the five highest-grossing films of all time—_Avatar, Avatar: The Way of Water_, and _Titanic_—were directed by Cameron.

## The Russo Brothers: $6.8 billion
Anthony and Joe Russo speaking at 2026 Comic-Con International: San Diego | Amy Sussman/GettyImages
The third-highest-grossing director is actually a pair of brothers who have made a name for themselves with comic-book superhero movies that ended up on the big screen. Anthony and Joe Russo are best known for their Marvel franchise movies, including _Captain America_ and Avengers films. _Avengers: Endgame_ is the second-highest-grossing movie of all time, and its prequel, _Avengers: Infinity War_, also makes the top 10 list.

## Peter Jackson: $6.6 billion
Peter Jackson, New Zealand director of The Lord of the Rings | Robert Patterson/GettyImages
Peter Jackson has directed films like _King Kong_ and documentaries about The Beatles, but it’s his work in Middle-earth that has made him the most money. Jackson's Lord of the Rings trilogy, released in 2001, 2002, and 2003, made him the most cash at the box office, followed by additional films covering the series' prequel, _The Hobbit_. In 2004, _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_, the final installment in the series, earned Jacksonthree Oscarsfor Best Picture, Best Writing, and Best Director. It was also his highest-grossing movie.

Michael Bay at "Transformers One" New York Premiere | Jamie McCarthy/GettyImages

His 2011 hit _Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ is his highest-grossing film.

His highest-grossing film, _The Dark Knight Rises_, is part of his gritty _Batman_ trilogy. A film director is one of the most pivotal members of any movie production. They are what gives the film its look and feel as the director attempts to bring together the best possible cast and crew to deliver a movie that captivates audiences, shapes culture and brings people to the theaters in droves.
There are some names in the movie business that are tapped to do it again and again. The Steven Spielbergs, James Camerons and Christopher Nolans are the names that Hollywood turns to, who have become almost as A-list as the actors on the screen and have been driving decades of box office success.
These are Hollywood’s best directors of all time, ranked by global box office gross.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
Here’s an overview of the top grossing film directors:

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **9. Tim Burton ($4.88 billion)**
Few directors have a more distinct and clear style than Tim Burton. Known for his Gothic fantasy vibes, Burton has been behind the camera of twisted comedies like _Beetlejuice_, _Edward Scissorhands_, _Mars Attacks!_ and _Alice in Wonderland_.
He put the Goth in Gotham with _Batman_ and _Batman Returns_, and he got his start on _Pee-wee’s Big Adventure_.
Burton’s most recent work was the follow-up to _Beetlejuice_ titled _Beetlejuice Beetlejuice_.
**Tim Burton’s highest-grossing film:**_Alice in Wonderland_ at $1.03 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **10. J.J. Abrams ($4.64 billion)**
J.J. Abrams became a go-to man in Hollywood with the massive success of _Lost_, which was the show of the early 2000s.
His first major film directorial job was _Mission: Impossible III_, which is when the series took a massive leap in production, before helping to revive the _Star Trek_ film series.
Abrams was then tasked to revive the _Star Wars_ film series, and _Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ remains his highest-grossing film of all time and top five overall.
**J.J. Abrams’s highest-grossing film:**_Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ at $2.07 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **11. Robert Zemeckis ($4.4 billion)**
Being behind one of the most iconic film franchises of the 1980s, Zemeckis directed all three _Back to the Future_ films, a culture-defining series.
He also directed _Forrest Gump_, for which he won an Academy Award, _Cast Away_, _Flight_ and the cult classic _Who Framed Roger Rabbit_.
**Robert Zemeckis’s highest-grossing film:**_Forrest Gump_, which brought in $678 million.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **12. Jon Favreau ($4.34 billion)**
Favreau got his start as an actor, breaking through with his role in _Swingers_. But he made his mark as a director with two very different films.
The first was _Elf_ in 2003, which remains a holiday classic. And then came _Iron Man_ and _Iron Man 2_, which helped kick off the Marvel Cinematic Universe and made him one of the most influential figures in that franchise.
Favreau made his own personal passion project in _Chef_ before finding his way into remakes of Disney classics in _The Jungle Book_ and _The Lion King_.
Favreau’s most recent endeavor as a director has been _The Mandalorian_ TV series and the new _Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu_ film, which hit theaters in May 2026.
**Jon Favreau’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lion King_ at $1.66 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **13. Ron Howard ($4.31 billion)**
Ron Howard has been an influential part of Hollywood since the late 1960s as an actor in _The Andy Griffith Show_ and _Happy Days_.
As a director, _Apollo 13_ made him a directorial household name. _A Beautiful Mind_, _Cinderella Man_ and _How the Grinch Stole Christmas_ showed off his versatility as a director among multiple genres.
**Ron Howard’s highest-grossing film:**_The Da Vinci Code_, which earned $758 million worldwide.
